recommendations.why: Fits a straight-line model that predicts a numeric outcome from one or more numeric predictors, by least squares. It uses revenue (f64), seats (u16), score (f64), signup (date) and churned (packed_bool).

alternatives.when: the outcome is yes/no (0/1) or a count
you want intervals that combine the data with prior knowledge about the coefficients
you only want how closely two numeric fields follow a straight line together
the predictor is a set of groups and you want to know whether the group averages differ
you want each row's residual, to check the residual assumptions or find rows the model fits badly
